# Kevin Geraldez 

 

### Tenure

2020 – 2025

### Title

Senior Project Designer

### Signature

 Kevin Geraldez is a Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2020 to 2025. He specializes in graphic design and works on the Premium, RLC and Elite 64 lines alongside Steve Vandervate. Prior to working at Mattel, he was a graphic designer at various toy companies, including some competing brands such as Jada Toys, Maisto and Jakks Pacific. Geraldez's first graphic design was the Initial D-exclusive Toyota AE86 Sprinter Trueno, and has also worked on other products such as the Kawa-Bug-A, 1975 Chevrolet Monte Carlo and the Car Culture Hyper Haulers series.
